title: REQ · A typed event bus defines Phaser to React and React to Phaser events
summary: A dependency-free typed emitter carries two event maps with compile-time-checked payloads.
description: Context: no bridge exists between Phaser and React. Desired behavior: create src/phaser/events.ts with PhaserToReactEvents (objectHover {id: string|null}, objectClick {id: string}, sceneReady {sceneId: string}) and ReactToPhaserEvents (highlightObject {id: string|null}, playAnimation {target: string, name: string}, transitionTo {sceneId: string}). Provide createEventBus<T>() with on (returning unsubscribe), off, emit and clear, and two exported buses. Expected result: typed delivery with no Phaser import. Why: React and Phaser need decoupled communication.
acceptance_criteria: Given a listener on objectClick, When emit('objectClick', {id:'bookshelf'}) runs, Then the listener receives {id:'bookshelf'} once.
Given the unsubscribe returned by on is called, When emit runs again, Then the listener is not called.
Given clear() is called, When any event is emitted, Then no listener is called.
Given the events module, When it is imported, Then it does not import phaser.
technical_constraints: TypeScript generics keyed by event map
definition_of_done: events.ts typechecks with generic event maps
